## M47. Rule counts' "anything else" growth is a change of king, not the king's splits (this review)
- It read -17.4 (median -5.5), but in the 3 kept r499 replays the king line (replays.king_meals) was 3, 9 and 8 long at r397 and lost
  0, 2, 0 to its own splits and sprints. Change: report the king line's r396 length and its split/sprint losses as their own rows.
- Fixed (orch/m47-king-rows f63674b, merged to main): rule counts trace the king line (replays.king_line); a split-out's old head is the king's own loss and a handover is only a split whose parent is the longer piece. On review 1790479726158070000's 5 kept r499 replays our r396-r499 losses are pieces the king split off -6.2, sprints 0, handovers -4.8, the longest's lead at r396 -8.4: a change of king is -13.2 of -19.4 and the king's own splits -6.2 (suggestive, n = 5 games; breeder/0004 alone gives -64 of the -97).
